At launch, we are proud to offer an array of core therapies, each personalized to support your unique path toward healing and long-term wellness.

list.title: Telehealth

about.textOne: Specializing in medication management and mental health intervention services. patientJourney.heading: Patient Journey and Process
patientJourney.imageAlt: Patient showing signs of distress while sitting with laptop

steps.title: Booking and Initial Assessment
steps.description: Patients can book appointments directly through the website using Zocdoc integration. New patients will undergo an initial assessment to establish care and begin treatment.

steps.title: Treatment Path
steps.description: Following the initial assessment, patients will receive ongoing medication management and, when necessary, be introduced to additional services like psychotherapy or telehealth follow-ups.

steps.title: Follow-up Appointments
steps.description: Patients will typically attend monthly in-person follow-up appointments to ensure progress and make medication adjustments as needed.

seo.metaTitle: Mental Health Treatment Center in California | Medication Management & Psychotherapy | Clear Path
seo.metaDescription: Clear Path provides evidence-based mental health treatments including medication management and psychotherapy for depression, anxiety, PTSD, and bipolar disorder. Located in Orange County, CA.

services.heading: Services
services.description: Clear Path offers a variety of additional services to support your care journey:

services.title: Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
services.description: Plans to implement mental health outpatient care and psychiatric services, including medications such as Suboxone, Methadone, Vivitrol, and Subutex.

services.title: Sober Living Placement
services.description: Strong partnership with Sober Living ensures access to supportive, substance-free housing environments.

services.title: Transportation Coordination
services.description: Assistance in arranging transportation services to ensure clients can attend their sessions.

services.title: Nutritional Counseling
services.description: A nutritionist provides guidance on healthy eating habits and diet plans, with snacks and lunch available for full day treatment clients.

services.title: Case Management
services.description: Assistance with resume building, job search, court paperwork, and accessing community resources to help clients develop life skills and achieve long-term stability.

treatmentGrid.heading: What Makes Clear Path Unique?
treatmentGrid.description: A simple, personalized process that makes high-quality mental health care accessible and effective.
treatmentGrid.featuredImageAlt: Clear Path mental health treatment process and care journey

treatments.title: Expert Care, Close to Home
treatments.description: Clear Path sets itself apart by prioritizing in-person appointments. We understand the value of face-to-face interactions, which foster trust and better communication between patients and providers.

treatments.title: Cutting-Edge Treatments
treatments.description: From medication management to evidence-based psychotherapy, we use proven, up-to-date clinical approaches to deliver effective care.

treatments.title: Specialized Focus on Adults
treatments.description: Our services are exclusively designed for individuals aged 18 and older, allowing us to tailor treatments specifically for adult mental health needs.

treatments.title: Compassionate Environment
treatments.description: At Clear Path, we've created a welcoming space where patients feel supported and understood at every step of their journey.
